provenance.generator: integration/build_patient.py (M2C Indian-conditioned generation, indian_random_seed=137); demographics.age/state/urban_rural and risk_factors.* sampled from configs/indian_population.yaml (docs/DECISIONS.md D006); demographics.sex sampled from its Census-2011-derived national marginal; height_cm/weight_kg not modeled (out of M2C scope); ECG is metadata-only, no waveform attached (D003); lipid_panel TC/TG/HDL sampled (category-then-uniform, INDIAB-17), LDL DERIVED via Friedewald (never independently sampled, D011); lipid_interpretations COMPUTED per definition, never sampled (D011); labs.HbA1c generated only for non-diabetic patients, age+sex-conditioned (ICMR-INDIAB-12), conditional on the diabetes label above, never the reverse (M4-0B) — see docs/M4B_GENERATION_DESIGN.md; diagnoses are a 1:1 promotion of the hypertension/diabetes risk_factors flags, never independently sampled, diagnosed_date left null (no evidence-backed per-patient onset distribution exists); hyperlipidemia diagnosis deliberately deferred (D015); medical_history chronic_condition entries reference those diagnoses, not re-derived — see docs/M4D_DIAGNOSIS_HISTORY_DESIGN.md; medications generated only for hypertension/diabetes diagnoses, gated on ICMR-NNMS national treatment-rate Bernoulli draws (14.5%/36.1%), drug_class only (antihypertensive/antidiabetic), never a specific drug name; statin/antiplatelet medications not generated (no population treatment-rate evidence); start_date/stop_date left null (no per-patient initiation-date evidence exists), current_status always "active" (D016) — see docs/M4E_MEDICATION_DESIGN.md; blood_pressure (M8) SBP/DBP drawn from NFHS-5 age-band×sex truncated normals (PLOS ONE 2025, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0332226); per-band SDs DERIVED from that paper's published mean/95%-CI/n and cross-validated against the independently published NFHS-5 male overall SDs (PMC11068163) to within 0.8%; truncation region set by the hypertension label's OWN published definition (SBP≥140 and/or DBP≥90 and/or on antihypertensive), so BP is conditional on that already-primary label and NEVER used to re-derive it — a treated hypertensive's BP is left UNCONSTRAINED rather than forced high; ages above source coverage (men>54, women>49) hold the oldest band constant, flagged per record via blood_pressure.extrapolated_beyond_source_age_range; SBP/DBP correlation not modeled (no Indian source) — see configs/indian_population.yaml risk_factors.blood_pressure for all limitations; encounters contain ONE synthetic_baseline_assessment, a structural container for this record's single measurement cross-section — NOT an observed healthcare contact, no visit/admission/follow-up is generated (no Indian utilization evidence); clinical_timeline indexes that encounter by reference_id and emits no diagnosis-onset, medication-start or follow-up event; height_cm/weight_kg STILL null — no national mean+SD of Indian adult height by sex located in 6 research attempts (M4-0 x3, M8 x3), so BMI remains the evidence-primary anthropometric and weight stays derivable-but-underived; family_history (D020) diabetes / cardiovascular_disease (heart disease or stroke) in first-degree relatives: ages 45+ drawn from LASI Wave 1 observed marginals (14.33% / 11.61%), ages 20-44 MODEL-DERIVED by a calibrated parent simulation over LASI age-band x sex self-reported prevalence (no source covers 20-44), tagged per record via family_history.derivation; diabetes family history conditional on the patient's diabetes label via LASI's crude OR 3.80, never the reverse — see configs/indian_population.yaml risk_factors.family_history for all assumptions; air_quality (D021) is a deterministic lookup by state of the 2023 CPCB annual mean AQI (hourly station values -> city -> state, CPCB National AQI scale), NOT sampled and NOT the patient's own exposure: state resolution only, urban-station-weighted (flagged per record via air_quality.monitoring_bias), null with a reason for 9 states/UTs lacking adequate monitoring — see configs/indian_population.yaml environment.air_quality
